column1: # techneissa's fork: interface text for fork features, added to craft-i18n's locales/id/photocraft.tsv at build time (crates/ui-egui/fork_i18n.rs). Rows the official catalog already has are dropped.

column2: Models are optional and run entirely on this computer. Downloading fetches the model file from Hugging Face; no images or documents are ever uploaded. Without a model, Select Subject, Remove Background and Remove Subject use the built-in (non-AI) methods.
column3: Model bersifat opsional dan berjalan sepenuhnya di komputer ini. Pengunduhan mengambil berkas model dari Hugging Face; gambar atau dokumen tidak pernah diunggah. Tanpa model, Pilih Subjek, Hapus Latar Belakang, dan Hapus Subjek menggunakan metode bawaan tanpa AI.
